topics.label: Career & Work
topics.purpose: Read direction, position, resources, execution, structure and change only where the current ECR configuration already carries those owners.
topics.purposeZhHans: 只在当前 ECR 构型已命中的语义 owner 中，读取方向、位置、资源、执行、结构与变化。
topics.preview: Work becomes useful to read through the parts of this configuration that organize direction, role, resources and execution.
topics.previewZhHans: 事业主题只从当前构型已经出现的方向、角色、资源与执行结构进入。
topics.realityQuestion: In your current work situation, what is actually limiting movement: direction, position, resources, execution, or the surrounding structure?
topics.realityQuestionZhHans: 在当前工作现实里，真正限制推进的更像是方向、位置、资源、执行，还是周围结构？

topics.label: Relationship
topics.purpose: Read difference, response, shared carrying and relational coordination without producing a compatibility verdict.
topics.purposeZhHans: 读取差异、回应、共同承载与关系协调，不产生合不合或相容度结论。
topics.preview: Relationship is read through the parts of this configuration that organize response to another reality and shared structure.
topics.previewZhHans: 关系主题从当前构型中如何回应另一个现实、如何组织共同结构进入。
topics.realityQuestion: When difference appears in an important relationship, what happens next in reality: understanding, expression, repositioning, shared carrying, or withdrawal?
topics.realityQuestionZhHans: 重要关系出现差异时，现实中接下来通常发生什么：理解、表达、重新定位、共同承载，还是退出？

topics.label: Resources & Money
topics.purpose: Read available resources, exchange capacity, sustaining inputs and execution without predicting wealth or return.
topics.purposeZhHans: 读取可用资源、交换能力、持续输入与执行，不预测财富或回报。
topics.preview: Resources are read as what can be accessed, exchanged, sustained and converted into operation—not as a wealth prediction.
topics.previewZhHans: 资源主题读取什么可以被取得、交换、维持并转化为运行，而不是财富预测。
topics.realityQuestion: Which resource is actually scarce or constrained right now: time, money, attention, support, capacity, or execution?
topics.realityQuestionZhHans: 现在真正稀缺或受限的资源是什么：时间、金钱、注意力、支持、容量，还是执行能力？

topics.label: Family & Shared Structure
topics.purpose: Read roles, shared resources, carrying, stability and continuation inside a shared structure.
topics.purposeZhHans: 读取共同结构中的角色、共享资源、承载、稳定与持续。
topics.preview: Family is read as a shared operating structure: who carries what, how stability is maintained, and where reorganization may be needed.
topics.previewZhHans: 家庭主题被视为共同运行结构：谁承载什么、稳定如何维持，以及哪里可能需要重组。
topics.realityQuestion: What part of the family structure is being maintained by habit, role or unequal carrying rather than by current agreement?
topics.realityQuestionZhHans: 目前家庭结构中，哪一部分主要靠习惯、角色或不均衡承载维持，而不是当前共同认同？

topics.label: Self & Direction
topics.purpose: Read orientation, understanding, expression, agency and position without turning ECR into a personality type.
topics.purposeZhHans: 读取方向、理解、表达、行动与位置，不把 ECR 变成人格类型。
topics.preview: Self & Direction asks how this configuration organizes orientation and action, not what fixed type of person you are.
topics.previewZhHans: 自我与方向关注当前构型如何组织方向与行动，而不是把你归类成固定人格。
topics.realityQuestion: Where do you currently feel the largest gap between what you understand, what you express, and what you actually do?
topics.realityQuestionZhHans: 目前你在“理解什么、表达什么、实际做什么”之间，最大的落差在哪里？

topics.label: Timing & Change
topics.purpose: Read how the current motion and activation stages shape change around an already-selected ECR configuration.
topics.purposeZhHans: 读取当前运动与激活阶段如何影响已经选定的 ECR 构型变化。
topics.preview: Timing does not predict an outcome; it shows how change is currently entering, gaining weight, amplifying, aligning, decaying or closing.
topics.previewZhHans: 时间主题不预测结果，而是显示变化目前如何进入、增重、放大、对齐、衰退或闭合。
topics.realityQuestion: What has recently become easier to start, harder to sustain, more amplified, or closer to closure in lived reality?
topics.realityQuestionZhHans: 现实中最近有什么变得更容易启动、更难维持、被明显放大，或更接近结束？
